title: docs(adr): ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ note — a super-user set votes on every field of its object

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9A6kAUSDc7TXDVUJeUigpMx)_

Fixes #29106. This is the card's second PR: the ADR note for the runtime change that landed in #29387. It is governed (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H) and stays a draft for a governed approver.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6573563853

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只在 ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ 下追加一条 2026-11-02 的说明，记录裁决 6573563853 选 A:持「查看全部 / 修改全部」的权限集在字段合并中对该对象每个字段投票。Status 行不动。
- 为什么改：运行时改动已由 #29387 合入，ADR 需要如实记录现行规则。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档，无运行时影响；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 需要你做的：治理审批人(GOVERNED_APPROVERS)审阅并批准；本 PR 保持草稿，席位不会自行转为就绪。

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`: one append-only note under D2 ⑧, after the 2026-10-28 note. It records that a set holding `viewAllRecords` on an object votes `readable: true` on every field of it, and that `modifyAllRecords` votes `readable: true` and `editable: true`. View All never grants an edit. Who holds the bypass is the row-level answer, read through one function (`holdsSuperuserBypass`, `@objectstack/core`). Union without deny is otherwise unchanged. The note also names the one consequence: a set can no longer withhold a field from its own View All / Modify All holders.
- The Status line is untouched. Seat 2 ruled "note only", because earlier ⑧ notes (2026-10-26, 2026-10-28) left it alone.
- No changeset: a docs-only change publishes nothing.

## Why

The ruling of record 6573563853 (letter A) amended ⑧'s field-merge posture. #29387 shipped the runtime half, and this records it where the posture is written.
